extension.summary: CoreELEC (Amlogic) parsers for raw Dolby Vision and HDR10+ metadata payloads.
extension.description: A CoreELEC addon for CoreELEC 22 (Amlogic). Parses the DV/HDR sidedata JSON that CoreELEC's Amlogic video player publishes via player.process(video.sidedata), a CoreELEC-specific infolabel not present in stock Kodi: the RPU (Dolby Vision profiles 4/5/7/8), the dvcC/dvvC configuration record, HDR10+ ST 2094-40 dynamic metadata, and the static MDCV/CLL SEI payloads. Stdlib only, no required external dependencies; RPU parsing uses libdovi via ctypes (bundled for aarch64), HDR10+ parsing uses CoreELEC's own libavutil via ctypes (CoreELEC 22's ffmpeg 8.1.2, borrowed at runtime, never bundled). Both sections are None when their engine isn't available.
